verdict.rationale: Evidence explicitly documents third-party Hugging Face replicas (Open-Jev-9B/2B, openjev) built via LoRA on a different base model, clearly labeled as community reproductions of the 'System One idea' and not TypeSafe products, since Jev's actual weights are never published; a curated ecosystem list also states 'a listing is not an endorsement.' This gives real attribution clarity but the derivatives are reimplementations rather than true fine-tunes/quantizations of the actual closed model weights. Missing for 10: independent corroboration beyond one HF listing, and actual derivatives of the real official weights (impossible since Jev is closed-weight).
